title: Decide how a role's own status and the run's verdict relate, and say both in the feed
description:
Found by tick 54n (run epic-9pd, attempt 6), from a note on 54n.

In the ticks pwp run, closeout attempt 13's role_result said DONE_WITH_CONCERNS; collect classified the attempt as failed because it made no commits; and the feed line read 'closeout-epic answered failed (no-commits)' — as if the worker declared failure. It had not. That wording cost real diagnosis time.

Two separate questions, both needing a decided rule:
1. For a role whose deliverable may legitimately be a report plus findings (review, some closeouts), is 'no commits' a failure? Today it is, incidentally. For review it arguably should not be; for closeout, now that 54n lets it write learnings, it arguably should.
2. Whatever the verdict, the feed must not attribute the verdict to the worker. Say both: what the role answered, and what the run concluded and why.

Decide 1 per role and record it; fix 2 unconditionally.
acceptance_criteria: Each role has a recorded rule for whether no commits is a failure, enforced in collect; and a feed line for a collected attempt states the role's own status and the run's verdict separately, proven by a test where they differ
